page.layout: One column of printed text, centred in the left block under the running head; right margin empty apart from a blot. No notes, no page number.

main_text.head: De sacris Imperatorum personis Ecclesiæ primitivæ decem persecutionibus.
main_text.l: DE obedientia Christianorum in Ne-ronem, sub persecutione prima.
De obedientia Christianorum in Domi-tianum sub persecutione secunda.
De obedientia Christianorum, in Tra-janum sub persecutione tertia.
De obedientia Christianorum in Adria-num, Antonium, Pium, & Commo-dum Imperat. sub persecutione quarta.
De obedientia Christianorum, erga Se-verum Imp. sub persecutione quintâ[?].

page.notes: The Roman numeral in "quintâ" is hard to read. The mark over the a may be an abbreviation or a stray stroke. The reading is doubtful. The right margin shows only a blot and a ruled line, which are not printed text.
